summary: Employee replaced a managed phone; MFA prompts still target the retired device and the replacement has not completed compliance, so the employee Wi-Fi profile is absent.
category: Identity and Access / MFA and managed device enrolment
private_note: Verify the employee using the approved process. Then remove the retired authenticator, issue a temporary registration pass, and ask the employee to finish company-portal enrolment. Once the new phone reports Compliant, sync the portal and allow up to fifteen minutes for the employee Wi-Fi profile.

evidence.quote: Never request a password or a one-time code in a ticket.
The employee Wi-Fi profile is delivered automatically after the mobile device is enrolled and compliant.
